changelog:
LLM Cost Guard skill initial release:

- Real-time monitoring and alerting for LLM API spend, with configurable daily/monthly budgets.
- Per-user quotas, support for free and pro tiers, and multi-model pricing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama).
- Daily spend reports and alerts at budget thresholds, delivered via WhatsApp, Telegram, or Discord.
- CLI commands for logging, status, reports, and quota management; data stored locally with zero dependencies.
- Auto-installed cron integration for daily summaries, overage alerts, and counter resets.
summary: Monitors and enforces daily/monthly LLM API budgets per user/model, tracks token usage, and sends alerts to prevent overspending.
